title: De Novo Design, Directed Evolution and Computational Study of Heme-Binding Helical Bundle Protein Catalysts for Biocatalytic Enantioselective Ge–H Insertion
authors: Wei Huang; Gessica M. Adornato; Maggie Horst; Turki M. Alturaifi; Kaipeng Hou; Peng Liu; William F. DeGrado; Yang Yang
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦血红素结合螺旋束蛋白催化锗氢插入反应，虽涉及分子动力学模拟，但核心是蛋白质-小分子催化而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: De novo designed proteins offer a malleable platform for the development of stereoselective transformations not found in biochemistry. Here, we report the de novo design and directed evolution of helical bundle protein catalysts for enantioselective germylation through Ge–H insertion, a transformation not previously achieved by enzymatic catalysis. Comparative computational analysis revealed that, relative to Si–H insertion, the Ge–H insertion reaction proceeds through an earlier and more flexible transition state, introducing distinct challenges for stereocontrol. Using a fully de novo designed truncated four-helix bundle scaffold as the starting point, directed evolution afforded a quadruple mutant that catalyzes Ge–H insertion with high efficiency, enantioselectivity, and broad substrate scope. Molecular dynamics simulations indicated that beneficial mutations introduced from directed evolution enhanced active-site preorganization and modulated local back-bone flexibility, contributing to improved transition-state complementarity with fine-tuned binding pocket size and more stable cofactor positioning regulated by hydrogen bonding interactions. These findings showcase the excellent potential for de novo proteins to achieve stereoselective transformations previously unknown to biocatalysts and underscore the importance of active-site remodeling of de novo protein scaffolds via directed evolution in achieving selective catalysis involving flexible transition states. abstract_zh: 从头设计蛋白质为开发生物化学中不存在的立体选择性转化提供了一个可塑平台。在此，我们报告了通过Ge–H插入实现对映选择性锗化反应的螺旋束蛋白质催化剂的从头设计与定向进化，该转化此前尚未通过酶催化实现。比较计算分析揭示，相对于Si–H插入，Ge–H插入反应经历一个更早且更灵活的过渡态，为立体控制引入了独特挑战。以完全从头设计的截短四螺旋束支架为起点，定向进化获得了一个四重突变体，该突变体以高效率、高对映选择性和广泛的底物范围催化Ge–H插入反应。分子动力学模拟表明，定向进化引入的有益突变增强了活性位点的预组织，并调节了局部主链灵活性，从而改善了过渡态互补性，伴随精细调控的结合口袋尺寸以及由氢键相互作用调节的更稳定的辅因子定位。这些发现展示了从头蛋白质在实现生物催化剂此前未知的立体选择性转化方面的巨大潜力，并强调了通过定向进化对从头蛋白质支架进行活性位点重塑在实现涉及柔性过渡态的选择性催化中的重要性。目录图文摘要
